question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Candide, Bob gets Emma, and Claire gets Jane Eyre.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Bob and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Candide
(B) Emma
(C) Jane Eyre
solution:
Each row lists books in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (Candide, Emma, Jane Eyre)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (Emma, Candide, Jane Eyre)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (Emma, Jane Eyre, Candide)
3. Bob and Alice swap: (Jane Eyre, Emma, Candide)
Alice has Jane Eyre, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
